parent_event.cascade: same-side forced-order snapshots separated by at most 10 seconds
parent_event.tail: cascade notional at or above the shifted trailing 24-hour 99th percentile after at least 50 prior cascades
parent_event.delivery: ordinary aggregate-trade flow and price both move in the forced-order direction

state_transition.confirmation: within 10 seconds after the cascade ends, a strictly later completed second has both opposite active flow and opposite return and has left the cascade extreme
state_transition.unresolved: no opposite initiative means no trade

geometry.entry: close of the completed opposite-initiative second
geometry.stop: cascade trade-price extreme plus one basis-point buffer
geometry.target: last aggregate-trade close immediately before the cascade

known_data_limit: The public force-order stream exposes only the latest liquidation snapshot per symbol per 1000 ms window, so reported cascade notional is a lower bound.
limitations: diagnostic screen rather than NautilusTrader account
passing requires a separate NautilusTrader implementation and untouched validation
no success claim is allowed from this screen
